extName.message: Скорость видео: YouTube, RuTube, Дзен, VK
extName.description: Store listing title shown to Russian-speaking users. Site order matches the English title (owner's decision 2026-08-12): YouTube is what people recognise. The Russian locale itself is the point of the exercise — the sites this extension is for are Russian, yet 86% of installs came from English speakers because the store had a single English listing.

extDescription.message: Кнопки скорости, ползунок и горячие клавиши для YouTube, RuTube, Дзена и VK Видео. Без рекламы и слежки.
extDescription.description: Store listing summary in Russian. Keep it under 132 characters — Chrome's cap. Site order matches extName on purpose.
